title: Outcomes of private Moon landing attempts, 2019-2025

source.name: Compiled mission outcome record (Beresheet, Hakuto-R M1/M2, Peregrine Mission One, IM-1 Odysseus, IM-2 Athena, Blue Ghost Mission 1)
source.publisher: NASA CLPS program / company mission reports (SpaceIL, ispace, Astrobotic, Intuitive Machines, Firefly Aerospace)

notes: Of 7 private Moon landing attempts since 2019, only Firefly's Blue Ghost Mission 1 (March 2025) achieved a clean upright landing. The other 6 either crashed/missed the Moon (Beresheet 2019, Hakuto-R Mission 1 2023, Peregrine Mission One 2024, Hakuto-R Mission 2 'Resilience' 2025) or landed but tipped onto their side (IM-1 Odysseus 2024, IM-2 Athena 2025).
